description: Defines the interface for managing collections of CodeModule objects within the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including methods for accessing modules by address, index, or sequence, and copying the collection.

classes.name: CodeModules
classes.description: An abstract interface for a collection of CodeModule objects, providing methods for querying and copying the collection.

methods.name: module_count
methods.description: Returns the number of CodeModule objects contained.

methods.name: GetModuleForAddress
methods.description: Returns the CodeModule containing the specified address, or NULL if none.

methods.name: GetMainModule
methods.description: Returns the main executable's CodeModule, or NULL if none.

methods.name: GetModuleAtSequence
methods.description: Returns the CodeModule at the given sequence number, or NULL if out of range.

methods.name: GetModuleAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the CodeModule at the specified index, or NULL if out of range.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the CodeModules collection.
